format: UCWDC contests: supervising and scoring personnel

source.quote_free_summary: Contests are supervised by a UCWDC "certified" Contest Coordinator with "verified" Scoring Directors/Scrutineers using an "authorized" scoring system; scoring personnel are trained and tested by a UCWDC Scoring Examiner.

requirement: Contest Coordinator, Scoring Director and Scrutineer body roles gated on verified credentials; scoring-system authorization is an OD-01 matter.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6B): attestation record and credential records, surfaced through _compoc_blockers_qualifications. Not built.
interpretation_notes: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE: how certification or verification is evidenced. No UCWDC credential tier is designed until it is. Design only (PR-A, section 6B): no credential model, no attestation table, no test; no compliance claimed. Organizer attestation never clears this requirement and is never shown as governing-body certification.
decision_refs: OD-15 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now, Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
